environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL where AuthType is set to AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the function specifies a Condition block with StringEquals on lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType set to AWS_IAM, and the Principal is restricted to the IoT Core service role (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/iot-rule-action-role). The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 with body '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request that does not include a valid SigV4 signature from an authorized IAM principal. Additionally, the IoT Core rule action that invokes this function URL performs message validation via an IoT Core topic rule SQL statement that enforces schema: SELECT * FROM 'devices/+/firmware' WHERE isUndefined(firmware_path) = false AND startswith(firmware_path, '/opt/firmware/') = true. The Lambda function's execution environment has /proc/sys/fs/protected_symlinks set to 1 by the Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2023 default), though this only protects world-writable sticky-bit directories.

config.iot_topic_rule_sql: SELECT * FROM 'devices/+/firmware' WHERE isUndefined(firmware_path) = false AND startswith(firmware_path, '/opt/firmware/') = true
